name: Abdulfatai Ibn Zachariya
title: Python & Backend Developer
tagline: I build practical software — web backends, data tools and desktop applications — that solve real operational problems.
description: Portfolio of Abdulfatai Ibn Zachariya, a Python & Backend Developer building Flask web apps, data tools and desktop software.
about: I'm a Python developer who came into software from Analytical Chemistry (MTech, Federal University of Technology, Minna). Lab work taught me to be methodical, to trust data, and to keep digging until a problem is actually solved — habits I bring to every codebase.

Today I build backends with Flask, SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL, data tools with Pandas, and desktop applications with Tkinter. I recently built Cliqo, a web and mobile marketplace for finding trusted service providers, and I was the Backend Developer on SiteLedger, a fuel and asset operations platform built by a multi-team capstone through the NCDMB Digitalization Initiative (NDI).

I'm also a CAPM-certified project manager, hold an International Executive Certificate in Safety Management, and trained as a graphic designer — so I'm comfortable planning work, thinking about risk, and caring about how things look.
